description: KAYAK flight route overview between two city or airport codes (e.g. LON to PAR): up to 20 recent round-trip deals KAYAK found (airline, departure/arrival airport, departure time, duration, price in USD), the route's lowest recent price and KAYAK's published route insights as question/answer text (typical price range, cheapest month, day and airline, delays, flights per week). From KAYAK's public route page; not a live date search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

from.description: Origin IATA city or airport code, e.g. LON, NYC, JFK

insights.description: Include route insight answers: true (default) or false

to.description: Destination IATA city or airport code, e.g. PAR, MIA

name: travel_kayak
title: Travel Kayak
